rule: docs/GM-SUBJECT-WORLDS.md §5: swapping a cover's caption to an unrelated subject must change the grammar and at least two motifs, and the swap must be rejected. `mark` is the single canonical noun for each motif. `bbox` is the motif's measured zone on the shipped 1200x800 master (x0,y0,x1,y1); scripts/cp012-cover-accept.py reads the shipped pixels inside that zone and fails when fewer than 150 non-paper pixels are painted there or when less than 60 % of them survive the mechanical 640x800 centre crop. The swap verdicts are a written judgement against the shipped pixels.
crop_rule: One drawing, one mechanical crop. The master is 3:2; the 4:5 file is its 640x800 centre crop with no resampling, so every declared motif must sit inside x 280-920 of the master. scripts/cp012-cover-prep.py places the painted plate so that its measured ink box fits that window with 16 px of paper to spare.

covers.title: Japanese register: affection and closeness
covers.accent_note: docs/GM-SUBJECT-WORLDS.md §1 permits the lamp accent; the round-2 plate paints the lantern in paper-cream and ships no lamp pigment (measured: no pixel within dE 12 of #e8a93a), so the cover declares no accent rather than claiming one it does not carry. The lit-lantern accent stays with the world hero plate (CP-016).

motifs.name: paper lantern with ink cap and one rib
motifs.encodes: the district the lesson is set in
motifs.must_never_become: a skin on a non-language course; a carrier of kanji-like marks

motifs.name: noren panel with three slits
motifs.encodes: the threshold of entering — the L0 social frame

motifs.name: café counter edge with two stools and a cup
motifs.encodes: the ordering situation the dialogue happens in

swaps.reason: A lantern, a noren and a café counter cannot caption a document-inspection course; the grammar and every motif would have to change.
Nothing on this plate is a kitchen implement; a jug and a bowl cannot be read here, and the field-green linen of the parent world is absent.
The counter and its stools do not become a bench and a banneton; only the warm paper survives, which is exactly the failure the check names.

covers.title: Measuring together: a kitchen lesson
covers.accent_note: The accent is field green #2f6047 on the folded linen. Round 1 shipped a plum cloth (#6a3e74), which GM-SUBJECT-WORLDS.md §0 bans and ART-BIBLE.md §2 has no pigment for; the plum is gone from the art and from the pipeline.

motifs.name: blank measuring jug
motifs.encodes: the vessel the learner reads in task 1
motifs.must_never_become: graduated marks, a scale readout or a recipe quantity

motifs.name: mixing bowl with wooden spoon
motifs.encodes: the making the parent and child do together
motifs.must_never_become: a styled product still life with a brand

motifs.name: two oranges on the folded field-green linen
motifs.encodes: the fruit drink of the learner page; the parent-world accent
motifs.must_never_become: a finished dish presented as a tested result

motifs.name: kitchen table edge
motifs.encodes: the home bench and its scale
motifs.must_never_become: a café counter or a workshop bench

swaps.reason: A jug and a mixing bowl do not become a lantern and a noren; the plate carries no threshold and no street.
There is no manual and no paper stack here; the table edge alone cannot carry a document course.
No vehicle, no lift, no tool wall and no gasket ring; a kitchen still life is not a service bay at any palette.

covers.title: Reading a pack before you install it
covers.accent_note: GM §2 sets the subject accent to none for the workshop grammar. Paper, ink (with the dark cuff ink on the manual spine) and cream only; measured frame hue band is warm paper and brown, with no lamp, field, ochre, coral or plum pigment.

motifs.name: open manual with blank pages and ink spine
motifs.encodes: the manifest as the authority you read first
motifs.must_never_become: readable procedure text, a table of values or a page of steps

motifs.name: stack of blank sheets
motifs.must_never_become: a checklist of ticked items or a completion claim

motifs.name: bench edge
motifs.must_never_become: a kitchen table or a café counter

swaps.reason: A blank manual and a stack of sheets cannot read as a jug and a bowl; no kitchen vessel or fruit is on the plate.
No lantern, no noren and no café threshold; the plate would have to be redrawn, not recaptioned.
A stack of blank sheets is not a banneton and a bound manual is not a dough dome; only the cream paper survives the swap.

out_of_scope_note: The four demo course covers are not drawn on this card; they come from the product's own world pipeline (CP-015/CP-016) and must pass this same check there.
